name: Birth of the Game
summary: The Football Association writes the first Laws of the Game, the FA Cup begins and England meet Scotland in the first international.

name: Leagues and Professionals
summary: The Football League starts in England, professionalism spreads and the penalty kick arrives.

name: Football Goes Global
summary: FIFA is founded in Paris, Uruguay dominate Olympic football and the offside law is rewritten.

name: The First World Cups
summary: Uruguay host the first World Cup, Italy win twice and the Second World War stops international football.

name: Post-war Golden Age
summary: The Maracanazo, Hungary's Magical Magyars, Pelé's arrival and Real Madrid's five European Cups.

name: Total Football
summary: England win at home, Brazil keep the Jules Rimet Trophy and Ajax and the Netherlands reinvent tactics.

name: Stars and Tragedies
summary: Maradona's Mexico '86, Sacchi's Milan, the first Women's World Cup and the stadium disasters that changed the game.

name: The Money Era
summary: The Premier League and Champions League launch, the Bosman ruling frees players and transfer fees explode.

name: Tiki-taka and Superclubs
summary: Guardiola's Barcelona and Spain's three straight major titles define a possession-based decade.

name: VAR and the Global Game
summary: Video assistants, record transfers, Messi's World Cup, booming women's football and a 48-team World Cup.
